title: Bayesian-optimized flow workflow improves fragment-to-lead reaction yields
summary: A workflow combining data mining, high-throughput experimentation and closed-loop flow experiments guided by multi-objective Bayesian optimization improved yields in two direct two-step syntheses of protein kinase C inhibitor precursors, using 20-40 autonomous flow experiments per campaign. An accelerated variant reached comparable conditions in one week using about 60% less substrate. Yield values are not in the abstract, Bayesian optimization is one component of the workflow and no baseline optimizer comparison is stated in this ChemRxiv v1 preprint.
ai_technology: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization guiding closed-loop flow experiments after high-throughput experimentation and data mining

evidence.tested: Closed-loop autonomous flow experiments across four reaction steps in two syntheses.
evidence.unknown: Absolute yield numbers and comparison with other optimizers; peer-review status; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization steered closed-loop flow experiments to refine reaction conditions.
